about.introduction: Hello! I'm Azeeza Shaik, a Computer Science and Engineering student passionate about software development and emerging technologies. I enjoy learning new technologies, building creative projects, and improving my programming skills. I am continuously working towards becoming a skilled Software Engineer through practical learning and hands-on experience.
narrative: I am currently pursuing my B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering at St. Mary's Women's Engineering College (2024–2028) with a current CGPA of 7.86.

I have practical knowledge across C, Python, Java, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern full-stack web stacks. I have completed certified training in Web Development through Internshala and MEAN Stack through Aajhub, as well as the AI Skill Passport by EY & Microsoft.

My hands-on projects include FoodBridge (a food waste management platform) and an AI-Powered Project Risk Intelligence & Early Warning System. I also completed a 2-month animation internship that enriched my visual design and user presentation capabilities.
My goal is to secure an internship opportunity where I can contribute to impactful software engineering projects, collaborate with industry mentors, and build innovative solutions.
